mapper.insert: insert into jsh_sequence (seq_name, min_value, max_value, current_val, increment_val, remark) values (#{seqName}, 1, 999999999999999999, 0, 1, #{remark}) on duplicate key update seq_name = seq_name
mapper.update: update jsh_sequence set current_val = current_val + 1 where seq_name = #{seqName}
mapper.select: select current_val from jsh_sequence where seq_name = #{seqName}
